main_text.p: Zypæus Not.jur. Belgici. tit. de Pugnant. in duell. Philipp. 2 edict. 22.Jun. 1589. Albert. & Isabell pen.Febr uar. 1610. & 11.Jul. 1614. l.Sancimus. Cod. de Poen. Arg §.1. v.con-sentanê-um- Inst. quibus. mod.. Toll. ob lig.l nihil tam naturale D. de Reg. jur tit.De-cret. de Purgat. vulg. & tit.de partes, & idoneis modis,offen- si honoris reparationem cu- ret. Unde etiam plura Principum Belgii edicta lata, quibus duellantium coerceatur furor, & nihilominus ejus quod censetur amissum, recuperandi remedium exhibea- tur.

Ne dicam quod nulla sit proportio inter delictum & poenam, qualem tamen jura civilia exigunt. Si quae enim injuria verbis fuerit illata, illa re ipsa, & ipso facto vindicatur. Ut utrinque injuriæ factæ compensari nequeant. Quemadmodum enim nec verbis satisfecerit, qui re deliquit; ita vice versâ nec re eum satisfacere necessum est, qui nonnisi verbis læsit. page.notes: The note column is printed in very small type. Several words are doubtful: "Not.jur." (possibly "Nov.jur."), "2 edict." (the "ct" may be a ligature), "Arg §.1." (the symbol is uncertain), "Inst." (possibly "Inft."), and "Isabell" with its following word. These readings are marked or uncertain in the text as far as the scan allows. Two words are uncertain: "Præterquam" (the abbreviation over the first e is hard to read) and "femet" (the scan is faint). Both are copied as best read, with no [?] added.
